normalization.falsification: Revise the need for a delegated payment account if a matched sandbox shows a simpler subscription or prepaid token meets the task at lower total cost and risk.
normalization.freshness: Exact video, private media and automatic captions checked 2026-10-21. Coinbase protocol, policy and Advisor pages checked the same day. Adoption numbers and anecdotal trading outcomes were not independently audited.

claims.proposition: The x402 protocol lets a server return a payment challenge and a client retry with signed proof before resource delivery.
claims.assessment: Coinbase's developer documentation describes the request, signature, facilitator verification and settlement flow.
claims.limits: Protocol mechanics do not by themselves authorize a model's business purchase or guarantee delivered quality.
claims.temporalScope: Video uploaded October 20, 2026; source and linked pages checked 2026-10-21. Results and product settings may change.

claims.proposition: The speaker presents growing x402 activity as evidence of agent-payment demand.
claims.assessment: Retained caption cues place the adoption argument around the 03:13 publisher chapter.
claims.limits: No independent dated denominator for unique users, real businesses or useful agent jobs was established.
claims.temporalScope: Video uploaded October 20, 2026; source and linked pages checked 2026-10-21. Results and product settings may change.

claims.proposition: The speaker recounts an agent-assisted weekend short-position anecdote.
claims.assessment: Private caption cues locate a first-person account near 08:14.
claims.limits: No audited trade ledger, fee accounting, risk-adjusted return, authorization trace or regulator source was qualified.
claims.temporalScope: Video uploaded October 20, 2026; source and linked pages checked 2026-10-21. Results and product settings may change.

claims.proposition: Coinbase describes Advisor as non-discretionary, with trading requiring the user's explicit approval.
claims.assessment: The current Coinbase Advisor product page states the user reviews and authorizes every trade.
claims.limits: This is a first-party description, not a regulator audit; the named registered entity is Coinbase Advisors, LLC, not the AI model.

relationships.reason: Both ask who the billing principal is when software buys a service. This Reader focuses on a delegated payment and settlement boundary; the earlier one on service identity and business advantage.
A purchased resource needs destination readback and a stop path before an uncertain retry, extending the earlier Reader's external-action boundary. Neither source proves the other's results.
